subject: Incident playbook acknowledgement and evidence acceptance
messages:
From: Clara Ruiz <clara.ruiz@greylend.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: incident playbook & evidence acceptance for SOC 2 tabletop

Hi Karthik, Marissa —

Thanks again for joining our prep call this morning. As discussed, Greylend is running a SOC 2 tabletop with our auditors on 2028-08-10 and we need two things from Redwood by 2028-07-25: a) a copy of your incident response playbook (redacted as needed) we can include in our evidence set, and b) a short index of the artifacts you can provide if we trigger an evidence request (logs, S3 extracts, identity change history, k8s audit, post-incident telemetry snapshots).

Please also confirm any redaction constraints and a contact for rapid evidence handoff if we need a live window. 

I attached a preliminary SIG/Caiq questionnaire our auditors flagged — not everything is required, but it highlights the ask areas.

Appreciate a quick acknowledgement so we can show QA that the vendor evidence path is in progress.

Thanks,
Clara Ruiz
Head of Vendor Risk — Greylend Financial

Attachment: Prelim_SIG_ques.pdf (application/pdf)
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Clara Ruiz <clara.ruiz@greylend.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: incident playbook & evidence acceptance for SOC 2 tabletop

Clara —

Acknowledged. We'll provide a redacted IR playbook and an evidence inventory by 2028-07-25. Quick clarifications so we scope correctly:

- Do you need the full runbook or a 2–3 page executive summary for auditors?
- Is the ask limited to telemetry from the last 12 months or the full retention window?
- For live evidence handoff, do you prefer SFTP or temporary IAM role access to an evidence bucket?

Planned next steps from our side:
1) Share Redwood_IRP_v2.3.pdf (redacted) and a short playbook summary.
2) Provide a matrix mapping artifacts we can deliver (logs, EBPF traces, token-redaction samples) and typical SLAs for handoff.
3) Confirm point-of-contact for on-call evidence liaison.

Marissa, can you take the artifact matrix and drop a first pass by EOD Thursday? Jonas — please standby for SFTP window coordination if Greylend wants that approach.

Karthik
VP, Infrastructure & Security Operations
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Clara Ruiz <clara.ruiz@greylend.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Jul 2028 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: incident playbook & evidence acceptance for SOC 2 tabletop

Thanks Karthik, Clara —

I'll assemble the evidence matrix and a two-page executive summary of the IR playbook (highlighting containment, escalation, and redaction policy). Tentative delivery: 2028-07-24 COB.

Mutual action plan (proposed):
- 2028-07-24: Redwood sends playbook summary + artifact matrix (redwood_contact@redwood.ai)
- 2028-07-25: Greylend confirms acceptance or requests redaction
- 2028-08-03: Dry-run evidence handoff (if needed)
- 2028-08-10: SOC 2 tabletop

Jonas — please add the SFTP/temporary-role runbook and expected time-to-provision to the matrix.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
From: Greylend Security <security@greylend.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Jul 2028 11:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: incident playbook & evidence acceptance for SOC 2 tabletop

Marissa/Karthik —

Thanks — that timeline works. We've uploaded an initial SOC 2 mapping workbook for your team to populate and also sent a DocuSign for a standard evidence acknowledgement (we need an authorized signature on record).

Links:
- Greylend_SOC2_Mapping.xlsx (please populate columns B:E with available artifacts and typical SLA for delivery)
- DocuSign: https://docusign.gov/txn/abcdef1234567890

If you prefer Redwood to redline the acknowledgement and return, let us know — otherwise the DocuSign route is easier for our auditors.

Regards,
Greylend Security Team
Attachment: Greylend_SOC2_Mapping.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Clara Ruiz <clara.ruiz@greylend.com>, Greylend Security <security@greylend.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Incident playbook acknowledgement and evidence acceptance

Clara / Greylend —

We've completed the requested items and returned the acknowledgement via DocuSign (signed by Redwood Legal). Deliverables (attached or linked):

- Redwood_IRP_v2.3.pdf (redacted executive summary + table of responsibilities) — attached
- Evidence matrix (populated): uploaded to shared drive and columns B:E completed per your workbook
- Provisioning options: temporary IAM role for S3 evidence bucket (recommended) or time-bound SFTP window — see matrix for provisioning lead times

Quoted for clarity:
> "We need two things from Redwood by 2028-07-25: a) a copy of your incident response playbook... and b) a short index of the artifacts you can provide..."

Status/next steps:
- Greylend to confirm receipt of signed DocuSign record (if you don't see it, our Legal can re-send).
- Marissa will coordinate a dry-run window the week of 2028-08-03 and provide the on-call evidence liaison details.

Attachments: Redwood_IRP_v2.3.pdf (application/pdf)
Shared link: https://drive.redwood.company/shared/greylend-ir-mapping

Thanks — looking forward to the tabletop.

Karthik Iyer
VP, Infrastructure & Security Operations
Redwood Inference
